description.zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线。
description.en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because it will be deprecated.

description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。**ClientToken**只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. **ClientToken** can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

description.zh: 页码，取值为大于**0**且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为**1**。
description.en: The page number. The value must be an integer greater than **0** and cannot exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: **1**.
The number of records per page. Valid values: **30**, **50**, and **100**. Default value: **30**.

description.zh: 数据订阅实例所在地域的ID，详情请参见[支持的地域列表](~~49442~~)。
description.en: The ID of the region where the change tracking instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~49442~~).

description.zh:
订阅实例名称。
> 传入本参数后，DTS将在调用结果中返回包含该名称的订阅实例。
description.en:
The name of the change tracking instance.
> If you specify this parameter, DTS returns the change tracking instances that contain the specified name in the response.

description.zh: 数据迁移实例的标签，作为过滤项，当此项不为空时，仅拥有此标签的实例会返回。
description.en: The tags of the data migration instance. These tags are used as filter conditions. If this parameter is specified, only instances that have the specified tags are returned.

description.zh:
标签的键。
> - N表示传入第几个标签的键。例如：Tag.1.Key表示传入第一个标签的键；Tag.2.Key表示传入第二个标签的键。可以同时查询1~20个标签键。
- 不允许传入空字符串。
description.en:
The key of the tag.
> - N specifies the sequence number of the tag key. For example, Tag.1.Key specifies the key of the first tag, and Tag.2.Key specifies the key of the second tag. You can query 1 to 20 tag keys at a time.
- Empty strings are not allowed.

description.zh:
标签的值。
>- N表示传入第几个标签的值。例如：Tag.1.Value表示传入第一个标签的值；Tag.2.Value表示传入第二个标签的值。可以同时查询1~20个标签值。
- 允许传入空字符串。
description.en:
The value of the tag.
>- N specifies the sequence number of the tag value. For example, Tag.1.Value specifies the value of the first tag, and Tag.2.Value specifies the value of the second tag. You can query 1 to 20 tag values at a time.
- Empty strings are allowed.

title.zh: 查询订阅实例列表及各实例详情
title.en: Query change tracking instances and their details

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts describe-subscription-instances --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-size 30 --page-num 1 --subscription-instance-name 'MySQL订阅' --client-token 0c593ea1-3bea-11e9-b96b-88e9fe630000 --account-id 123233440000 --tag Value=testvalue1 Key=testkey1 --resource-group-id rg-aekz4us4iruleja --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
